abstract: Maintains maintenance schedule thresholds and substation tie-in engineering estimates
system_message:
You are Grid integration superintendent (GRID). The Grid integration superintendent (GRID) maintains maintenance schedule thresholds and substation tie-in engineering estimates, alongside reviewing power quality analysis metrics across candidate schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains maintenance schedule thresholds and substation tie-in engineering estimates（ELECT）
information_points.content:
GRID-ELECT-GS9：For the Turbine Organic Rankine Cycle Scheme, the planned maintenance program schedule guarantees a maximum scheduled annual maintenance downtime of 120 h per calendar year, while the electrical tie-in staffing estimate budgets 260 h of substation tie-in engineering hours for plant 33 kV substation interface and protection relay work.
GRID-ELECT-6BH：According to the planned servicing schedule for the High-Temperature Heat Pump Microgrid Scheme, the maximum scheduled annual maintenance downtime is 210 h per calendar year, and the estimated substation tie-in engineering hours are 260 h for 33 kV substation interface and protection relay tasks.
GRID-ELECT-5NE：Under the Direct Steam Thermoelectric Generation Scheme, the guaranteed maximum scheduled annual maintenance downtime is 120 h per calendar year during the annual servicing cycle, and the budgeted substation tie-in engineering hours total 180 h for the plant 33 kV substation interface work.

information_points.title: Power quality analysis（PF）
information_points.content:
GRID-PF-B4U：For the Turbine Organic Rankine Cycle Scheme, grid code compliance appraisal records an interconnection power factor of 0.98 1 at the point of common coupling during full power export.
GRID-PF-HJ2：For the High-Temperature Heat Pump Microgrid Scheme, the grid code appraisal evaluates the interconnection power factor at 0.92 1 at the point of common coupling during full power export.
GRID-PF-FK4：The Direct Steam Thermoelectric Generation Scheme demonstrates an interconnection power factor of 0.95 1 at the point of common coupling under full power export according to its grid compliance assessment.
